subject: Acme Financial — workspace bootstrap, access gate, and API key plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@acmefinancial.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Handoff: Acme Financial initial org + access provisioning

Hi team,

Thanks for the intro call this morning with Acme. Per our conversation, they are ready to move from evaluation to an initial sandbox workspace and want a clear, low-friction plan for: project namespaces, admin/user roles, API key seeding, and an invite schedule for 12 power users.

High-level asks from Acme:
- Isolated project for integration testing (non-prod) + a production project
- Admins (2), Developers (6), Observability viewers (4)
- API keys seeded for service accounts and one short-lived deploy key
- SSO is on their roadmap but not required for M1 launch

I've attached the SOW and a draft access matrix. Can Jonas and Ben own the implementation play and confirm a timeline? Elena — please confirm target go-live window (they mentioned "end of November" during call).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW), Redwood_ACME_Org-Access-Matrix.xlsx (draft)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@acmefinancial.com>, Jason Lee <jason.lee@acmefinancial.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme Financial initial org + access provisioning

Thanks Monica — looping in Ben for the implementation details. Proposed plan below; please flag anything missing.

1) Timeline (target):
- Day 0 (Nov 9): Create tenant and two projects (acme-nonprod, acme-prod).
- Day 1 (Nov 10): Seed admin accounts and provision initial API service account keys.
- Day 3 (Nov 12): Invite user groups and validate role bindings and quota limits.
- Buffer/QA (Nov 13-18) and final sign-off by Acme.

2) Roles & mapping (action: Ben to share exact role names).
- Tenant Admin (2): full console + key rotation.
- Project Developer (6): deploy & test tokens, read usage.
- Observability Viewer (4): dashboards only.

3) API key plan (action: Ben)
- Create 2 long-lived service keys for pipeline use (stored in Acme vault).
- 1 short-lived deploy key (7-day TTL) for CI during initial rollout.
- Rotate and escrow keys following Redwood keying-playbook.

4) Security/compliance notes
- We'll provide audit logs for the onboarding window and hand over rotation events.
- If Acme requires SOC evidence, Monica please attach the questionnaire in a follow-up.

Ben — can you draft the exact CLI/console steps and prepare the keying-playbook.md with explicit commands? Elena/Jason — please confirm Nov 10 as Day 1 for seeding or propose an alternative.

Cheers,
Jonas
Director, Solutions Delivery
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@acmefinancial.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T07:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme Financial initial org + access provisioning

On Mon, Nov 7, 2026 at 11:04 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben — can you draft the exact CLI/console steps and prepare the keying-playbook.md with explicit commands?

Attached is a concise playbook and the exact step sequence I ran in a recent sandbox (summary below). I've included the scripts and a pre-populated role-binding CSV in the Drive link.

Quick steps summary (console + CLI):
- Create tenant: redwood tenants create --name acme-financial --region us-west-2
- Create projects: redwood projects create --tenant acme-financial --name acme-nonprod --type nonprod
  and redwood projects create --tenant acme-financial --name acme-prod --type prod
- Create service account: redwood accounts create --tenant acme-financial --name ci-service --role service-admin
- Seed keys: redwood keys create --account ci-service --ttl 8760h   (store in vault: acme-vault)
- Add users by email via bulk invite: redwood users invite --file acme-invite-list.csv --roles-csv role-bindings.csv

Attachments: keying-playbook.md (includes rotation commands), Redwood_ACME_Org-Access-Matrix.xlsx (updated)

Notes / gotchas:
- Make sure the nonprod project has prefix caching disabled to avoid cross-tenant cache bleed during testing.
- We'll enable continuous batching but cap batch size at 16 for nonprod to keep latency realistic.

I'll be available for a 30m runthrough Nov 9 morning PT if that works for everyone.

- Ben
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena@acmefinancial.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acmefinancial.com>, Acme IT Provisioning <it-provisioning@acmefinancial.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme Financial initial org + access provisioning

Thanks Jonas and Ben — that plan looks good. Nov 10 for Day 1 seeding is fine. A couple of clarifying items from our side: 

1) For the service account keys — can we get guidance on recommended vault storage and an example rotation cadence?
2) For invites — are we able to pre-warm the accounts so our users have console access on Day 3?

Jason (IT) — I've copied you to confirm whether Acme can accept long-lived keys in a vault and whether we need to open firewall rules to redwood endpoints (we have strict egress rules).

We'll plan to join the Nov 9 runthrough if available.

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Product Integrations
Acme Financial
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acmefinancial.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@acmefinancial.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme Financial initial org + access provisioning

Elena — quick answers from IT: 
- Vault: We use HashiCorp Vault and can accept long-lived service keys, but we require a rotation plan. Recommended cadence: 90 days for long-lived keys; 7 days for short-lived deploy keys. Please include the Vault paths and a sample rotation CLI in the deliverable.
- Networking: We'll open egress to the listed Redwood endpoints. Can you provide a minimal IP/domain allowlist?

Jonas/Ben — can you attach the key rotation example and the minimal allowlist to the Drive folder? Once we have those we can confirm the firewall change window (target Nov 11 0200-0500 PT).

Thanks,
Jason Lee
Director, IT Infrastructure
Acme Financial
